Legal

Privacy Policy

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly, such as your name and email when you use our contact form. We also collect usage data through analytics, including pages visited and time on site. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used solely to respond to your enquiries, fulfil orders, and improve the DOMIINIQUE experience. We may send occasional newsletters if you have opted in ? you may unsubscribe at any time.

3. Cookies & Local Storage

This website uses browser localStorage to remember your theme preference (dark/light mode), audio preference, and shopping cart contents. No tracking cookies are used. You may clear your browser data at any time to reset these preferences.

4. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete any personal data we hold about you. To exercise these rights, please contact us through the contact form.

6. Third-Party Services

We use Google Fonts and CDNJS for font and script delivery. These services may collect standard server logs. Our audio uses Wikimedia Commons public-domain files as a fallback. Please review their respective privacy policies for details.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The most current version will always be available on this page. Continued use of the site following changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
